generationInputs.prompt:
Create a visual storyboard as a SINGLE IMAGE arranged in a 1-column by 6-row grid layout of vertical 9:16 panels. 

STYLE: Signature Pamela Colman Smith artistic illustrative style. Richly detailed pen and dark black ink line art with organic contours. Soft watercolor and gouache washes with visible paint-pooling borders. Vintage Edwardian folk-art and late nineteenth-century Art Nouveau aesthetic. Palette of saturated jewel tones (deep indigo, saffron yellow, madder red, moss green, terracotta). Rendered on heavy, off-white historic watercolor paper with a delicate tooth and subtle texture. 

GRID LAYOUT INSTRUCTIONS:
- The image is a single vertical composite divided into 6 equal vertical panels.
- Each panel has a small, clearly legible blue ink circle in the top-left corner with the panel number (1 to 6).
- Thin black ink borders separate each panel.
- Elegant historic hand-lettered calligraphy at the top or bottom of each panel.

PANEL CONTENTS:
- Panel 1 (Top): A vintage 'XV' tarot card sliding over dark textured velvet. Hand-lettered 'PEOR CONDENA' at the bottom.
- Panel 2: A close-up of an artist's hand using a dip pen to ink delicate tarot lines on aged parchment. Hand-lettered 'CLAVE OCULTA'.
- Panel 3: Symmetrical shot of two robed figures looking up at a high ancient stone pedestal. Hand-lettered 'DOS FIGURAS' at the top.
- Panel 4: Extreme close-up of a loose golden circular ribbon on a robed figure's neck; it is clearly wider than the head. A red hand-drawn arrow points to the gap. Hand-lettered 'ARGOLLAS SUELTAS'.
- Panel 5: Wide angle. A majestic winged figure seated on a tall stone pedestal. A golden flame glows below in a hearth. Symmetrical. Hand-lettered 'TU PROPIO MIEDO'.
- Panel 6 (Bottom): Symmetrical composition. The two figures walking forward away from the pedestal into a lush garden of white roses under a rising sun. Hand-lettered 'SUELTA TODO' at the bottom.
